historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved creating up to 34,945 gross square feet of office space in an existing building by converting retail space and adding new office space.
The existing Anchorage building, containing retail space, stood on the property.
The City Planning Commission approved converting about 5,500 square feet of retail space to 12 additional hotel rooms, for 137 rooms total.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization for conversion of approximately 32,000 square feet of retail and office space to use as a new hotel with approximately 50 rooms.
